model: EEM EM3XX / EM325 / EM355 / EM375 / EM327 / EM357 / EM377
description: MID energy meters with Modbus RTU or Modbus TCP: voltages, currents, powers, power factor, frequency, total, tariff, partial and balancing energies and mean values as floats
source: Phoenix Contact, User manual UM EN EEM-EM3xx, MID energy meters, Revision 00 (2018-09-17, 108591_en_00), Appendix A Modbus register

sources.title: UM EN EEM-EM3xx: MID energy meters, user manual
sources.note: Appendix A, tables A-5, A-7, A-9, A-11, A-13, A-15 (float) and A-17 (device information)

notes: Phoenix Contact EEM-EM3xx MID energy meters (EM325/EM355/EM375 with CT, EM327/EM357/EM377 direct). The floating-point register tables of Appendix A and the device information table; the integer tables (A-2 to A-4, A-6, A-8, A-10, A-12, A-14, A-16) carry the same values with fixed factors and are not in this map.
Addresses are the manual's decimal addresses; registers are read with function 03. Values are IEEE-754 floats in two registers, high word first (the manual reads words as AB-CD).

Where the manual's decimal and hexadecimal addresses disagree, the hexadecimal one is used: the partial and balancing energies from 5126 (0x1406) to 5144 (0x1418). The manual lists the total inductive apparent energy procurement Σ at 4372 like L3; it is at 4374 here. The second 'inductive reactive energy procurement' block (4416 to 4422) is taken to be the capacitive reactive energy procurement, following the order of the other blocks.
Tariff registers are not available on the Ethernet models.
